notes: Original artwork. Production import applies a strict alpha silhouette threshold and revised cell crops; RGB artwork is not repainted. Chroma-key experiment was not integrated.

prompts.prompt: Use case: character-reference. Edit target is this SIX-SPRITE fox production atlas. Preserve every sprite's exact position, proportions, colors, outlines and expression. Remove ALL decorative lighting, colored glows, bloom, dark background haze and shadows surrounding the six objects. The space outside the actual painted object silhouettes must be genuinely fully transparent (alpha zero), including the gaps between the two columns and three rows. The interiors of the fox parts must be opaque (alpha 255), clean crisp black ink edges with normal antialias only. No checkerboard, no solid background, no floor shadows. Do not change the six parts or add any joints. This is strict production alpha cleanup for a Spine atlas, not a redesign. Remove the faint halos completely, retaining the smooth bold black outline, orange fur, cream fur, red scarf, sword and facial details exactly.

Use case: character-reference. EDIT TARGET is the supplied orange fox swordsman. Create a professional Spine production atlas with EXACTLY 2 columns and 3 rows, six separate painted objects, transparent background, generous transparent padding per cell, NO checkerboard, NO labels, NO grid, NO joint circles. Match the reference's confident three-quarter pose, thick black ink outlines, short stocky body, large head, red scarf with gold flame clasp, cream chest and black paws. IMPORTANT: preserve connected anatomy and finished silhouette; do not turn this into little round sausage segments. Row 1 left: COMPLETE HEAD INCLUDING BOTH EARS, full muzzle, eyes, brows, nose, mouth and all cheek fur, confident expression exactly like reference, no neck socket. Row 1 right: ONE CONNECTED BODY from scarf collar to both feet, including the complete left arm with paw resting on hip, both thighs and both feet connected naturally to the broad torso, full ivory chest tuft, red scarf collar and flowing scarf end with gold flame clasp. NO head, NO tail, NO right arm, NO sword on this body. No outlined cut seams at crotch or shoulders, no ball joints, no oval caps. Paint hidden shoulder/root overlap solid matching fur. Row 2 left: one CONNECTED RIGHT ARM AND ENTIRE SWORD, shoulder fur through wrist and black hand gripping the gold sword hilt, blade points upward-right like reference, matching proportion, full sword visible, no disjoint elbow segments, hidden shoulder end has plain orange overlap with no outline across cut. Row 2 right: one full large curled orange-and-ivory TAIL, natural hidden orange root, reference exact fur shapes. Row 3 left: EXACT same complete head as row1 left, same size, silhouette, ears, angle and placement within cell, but closed smiling eyes and slightly happy mouth. Row 3 right: EXACT same head again with open surprised eyes and small surprised mouth, identical contour and ears. These are six isolated production sprites, NOT a full assembled character and NOT a scene. Full color, smooth bold silhouette, no mechanical-looking cuts or cap outlines. Retain original illustrated charm and proportions.

Use case: character-reference. Reference image is the orange fox swordsman. Draw this SAME fox as ONE complete seamless full-body THREE-QUARTER BACK view for a production 2D game sprite. Orange fur, huge triangular ears, large head, short broad body, cream tipped fluffy tail toward viewer-left, red scarf collar and trailing cloth, black paws and white ankles. A sword is held in its right hand pointing diagonally upward-right, visible beyond its right shoulder. It walks away toward upper right but feet in a stable standing pose, all limbs naturally connected, full body in frame with transparent padding, transparent background. Match original confident bold black ink contours, cream/orange flat shading, compact proportions, hand-drawn fur shapes. NO face visible, NO eyes or mouth on back, NO circle joints, NO outlined socket caps, NO seams at neck or hips. Do not segment or detach any part. NO ground, NO shadows outside character, NO words, NO checkerboard. This will be animated with a continuous weighted Spine mesh; the whole body must look like a finished painted character.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture, wide rectangular FULLY OPAQUE rock cliff wall material, seamless horizontally. Original bold ink-on-parchment illustrated forest game style: warm dark slate-grey stone, charcoal black confident irregular contours, broad angular stacked rock strata, restrained short woodcut hatch marks, some dark moss in cracks and muted sage moss along top edge. Orthographic straight-on flat material, NO perspective, NO lighting baked from one side, NO ground or sky, NO transparent holes, NO standalone rocks or props, NO words. Wall runs from left edge to right edge and fills entire canvas. Moderate details and big readable shapes, suitable for mapping onto the vertical sides of a real 3D raised terrain island and stone steps. Muted grey stone keeps the orange character readable.
